assumptions.statement: Site and three key-area polygons are provisional rough constraints copied from the repository package.
assumptions.impact: All area-sensitive geometry, metrics, figures and boards must be regenerated after official polygons arrive.
assumptions.trigger: Organizer supplies versioned official SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA files.

assumptions.statement: Provisional key-area rectangles are not verified against named station or road anchors.
assumptions.impact: Detailed-area moves are directional prototypes only and cannot support parcel or station-integration conclusions.
assumptions.trigger: Official key-area polygons and anchor relationships are published; recheck Issues #1029 and #846.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, road redlines, ownership, heritage controls, municipal utilities, fire access and engineering constraints are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No statutory control, demolition, investment, phasing or feasibility conclusion is asserted.
assumptions.trigger: Approved regulatory conditions and professional surveys become available.

assumptions.statement: Scenario operators, annual events, service levels and human-takeover protocols are conceptual governance proposals.
assumptions.impact: They require public consultation, owner/operator agreements, safety review, privacy impact assessment and procurement review before implementation.
